14308319068.title: Snow world Hyderabad || One of the biggest snow theme park in india
14308319068.description:
Snow world Hyderabad is located beside Indira park and right next to the Hussain Sagar lake on the lower tank bund road. This snow park was inaugurated on 28 January 2004. Owners are ocean Park multitec LTD. At the time of opening it was India's first and the biggest in the world and was only the third such snow park after the ones in Malaysia and Singapore. 

This snow world hyderabad also consists of rain forest , livine dead, kalledo and illusion. The internal area also called as the cryo zone , maintains a constant temperature of -5 degrees. For one hour session, a maximum of 300 visitors at a time can explore the different facilities such as kids snow play area, snow tube slide volleyball, basketball etc. A few months after it's inauguration a snowfall feature was added. Said to be the first of it's kind at any snow theme park in India. The visitors are exposed to snow fall for 5 mins just before a session ends.
